description: Developing interest in space exploration and spacecraft by creative gamified storytelling techniques
summary: This project is an interactive web based app that teaches students and early space enthusiasts about the space exploration and the hardware nasa has left on moon
details:
This is a vibe coded website on html, js, css that shows about apollo missions and the instruments left behind and their importance.

Chat gpt free version was used for this by prompting it with my own ideas and storyline.
